rule: Pre-registered on 2026-11-12, before any candidate ran: this file's rule, candidates and frozen hashes were committed first. Candidates: a kit seed and a layout seed per candidate, drawn from os.urandom (63-bit), in the order listed; candidate i's kit is keyed_env.sample_kit(numpy.random.default_rng(kit_seed), id) and its layout and noise seed is layout_seed. The frozen reference solution (solution/ at frozen_commit; the sha256 of every file it and the grader run are under `frozen`) runs each candidate ONCE, in drawn order, through the grader itself (tests/review/regrade.sh: a fresh container of the task image with the verifier's resources and layout, the submission that solution/solve.sh writes, a one-episode plan). A candidate is kept when the reference completes its kit: kit_complete 1 (all three nuts assembled and still seated, none ruined), with no abort, no fault and no controller-budget cut. The hidden set (tests/ref/episodes.json) is the first 10 kept candidates in drawn order. Should fewer than 10 of the 16 be kept, 8 more candidates are drawn the same way, appended and run, and so on. Every drop is recorded with its reason; the hollowing check compares the kept kits' features (turn sizes and directions, dead ends, false entrances, mass, friction, reach, peg spacing) with all candidates'. The reference is deterministic on a candidate (it acts on the real observation's proprioception from _gt; layout and noise follow from the seeds), so the anchor's full verify of the set must repeat every kept run (kit_complete, nuts assembled, steps).

amendments.what: Round 2 of the maintainer review (2026-11-16, approved by the benchmark's owner after the first frontier measurement scored 0.92). (2) The agent's readable development simulator is replaced by a commissioning service: environment/Dockerfile installs environment/commission_service/ (the service program, a byte copy of tests/keyed_env.py and the development kits) for an account of its own, closed to the agent account, and sets the image's working directory to /; the agent's payload holds the cell's data sheet in place of the simulator. tests/verify.py and tests/keyed_credit.py change in their docstrings only.

amendments.what: Round 3 of the maintainer review (2026-11-17). (1) Tolerances: every episode is a real kit on the cell as it is that day. keyed_env.sample_unit draws, from the episode's layout and noise seed, each nut's own sector and layer boundaries, hole and groove radii, handle direction and colour shade, each peg's own shaft and pin, the finger pads' friction, each arm joint's friction (the Panda's identified curve, which the tracking law does not compensate), the wrench zero's drift, each camera's real mount and intrinsics (the published calibration and T_world_wrist stay the drawing's) and the lamps' brightness, each uniformly within its range (keyed_env.TOL; sources in tests/review/tolerances.md; every range is stated in the data sheet). A nut's friction against a peg is now the nut's own (0.3 to 0.7; the pegs' coefficient is 0.1). The credit rule's ground truth (keyed_credit.ground_truth) carries the real groove (actual), which the reference uses. (2) Takt: keyed_env.MAX_STEPS 1200 -> 1000 (100 s for a kit). The amendment changes what a kit is, so the hidden set is selected from fresh candidates and the development kits from fresh development candidates.

amendments.what: Round 3, second step (2026-11-17). Amendment 2 (tolerances, a 100 s takt) was not hard enough: the second frontier measurement's submission, unchanged, completed 9 of its 16 development kits, because 1.8 mm of radial clearance absorbed every tolerance and most of the cameras' calibration error. (1) The fit: keyed_env.SHAFT_R 0.011 -> 0.0123, a locating fit in the unchanged 25.6 mm hole (1 mm on the diameter, the fine series of clearance holes; 0.5 mm of radial clearance on the drawing, 0.35 to 0.65 mm with the tolerances; square edges, no lead-in chamfer). The nut and its groove are untouched. (2) The hand's two fingers are one mechanism, as on the real hand (an equality constraint between the two finger slides, keyed_env.FINGER_COUPLING): a gripped part is centred between them and cannot push them aside together, which a search for the shaft by touch needs and the reference, given the real poses, would not notice. The data sheet states the fit, the cell's compliance and what the wrist reads when a nut meets a shaft (section 12); sources and the clearances tried are in tests/review/tolerances.md. The amendment changes what a kit is, so the hidden set is selected from fresh candidates and the development kits from fresh development candidates.

amendments.what: The cameras' renderer (2026-11-18, asked for by the benchmark's owner). The cell's cameras are drawn by MuJoCo 3.16's Filament renderer on the CPU (tests/keyed_render.py with the look's numbers in tests/keyed_look.json and a render bundle of the laboratory around the cell, fetched at the dataset commit pinned in environment/assets.sha256) instead of MuJoCo's own OpenGL renderer: the robot's visual meshes, physically based materials, the room, the gantry's lamps with their shadows and an image light, fitted against path-traced references of the same laboratory. Unchanged: the physics, the wire, the cameras' poses and intrinsics with their errors of the day, the image sizes, the sensor noise, the published calibration and every tolerance (the lamps' brightness of the day multiplies every light of the new renderer). tests/keyed_env.py: render() draws through keyed_render; the model gains materials for the renderer that no geom uses; the lamps' brightness goes to the renderer instead of scaling the model's own lights, which are no longer drawn. The kits themselves are unchanged, so the rule runs on the same candidates. One number moves with what an image costs: the wrist image's charge, 0.25 s to 0.35 s (tests/grader_config.json, the default in tests/verify.py; a left or right image stays at 0.45 s). The reference asks for no image. environment/Dockerfile: the Vulkan CPU driver, the bundle's fetch into a folder only root and the service's account read, render checks for both accounts.
